fires.reason: Major chemical tank farm breach with volatile thermal anomaly (48.6MW). Multi-tender hazmat containment required immediately.
fires.action: DISPATCH Class B/C Foam units + hazmat suppression team. Evacuate 500m radius.

fires.reason: Solvent synthesis reaction runaway detected with high thermal intensity (41.2MW) within 500m of facility core.
fires.action: Activate GIDC disaster protocol. Deploy dry chemical + CO2 tenders. Alert district collector.

fires.reason: Hydrocarbon storage valve ignition exhibiting rapid FRP surge (44.8MW). Toxic vapor plume risk.
fires.action: Immediate 500m evacuation. Water spray curtain to prevent adjacent vessel exposure.

fires.reason: High-temperature industrial flaring emergency exceeding baseline threshold (52.1MW). Dense plume detected.
fires.action: Dispatch Port Trust & Municipal fire tenders. Mobilize emergency medical units.

fires.reason: Transformer yard & oil circuit breaker explosion. Heavy electrical/petroleum combustion (39.4MW).
fires.action: DO NOT USE WATER. Deploy dry powder & CO2 tenders immediately.
